Masala Thosai.note: Roasted with ghee = milk; mustard seeds; asafoetida (compounded hing is cut with wheat flour) = gluten, also in the sambar. Urad dal is not an allergen. Mild.

Plain Thosai.note: Cooked in vegetable oil; coconut chutney tempered with mustard seeds. Merchant tags vegan.

Ghee Roast Thosai.note: Pure ghee = milk. Served with the house coconut chutney, which Plain Thosai and Idli Set state is tempered with mustard seeds, so mustard is labelled too (judgement call).

Rava Thosai.note: Semolina (rava) is wheat = gluten; cashews = tree nuts. Cooked in oil, vegan. Green chilli, a little spicy.

Idli Set.note: Idli itself is rice + urad dal, but the sambar has asafoetida (wheat-cut hing) = gluten; chutney has mustard seeds. Sambar is mildly spiced (label 1).

Medu Vadai.note: Urad dal; asafoetida = wheat. A little spicy.

Masala Vadai.note: Chana dal (chickpea) is not an allergen; no asafoetida listed. A little spicy.

Onion Pakora.note: Gram flour (besan, chickpea) and rice flour, stated no wheat. A little spicy.

Samosa.note: Wheat pastry; mint chutney with curd = milk, so not vegan. Mild.

Chapati.note: Whole wheat; no ghee, no oil.

Puri Set.note: Wheat; potato masala with mustard seeds and asafoetida. Mildly spiced masala.

Paneer Butter Masala.note: Paneer, butter, cream = milk; cashew paste = tree nuts. Mild.

Dal Tadka.note: Sounds vegan (lentils) but tempered with ghee = milk; mustard seeds. Mild.

Aloo Gobi.note: Sunflower oil; no allergens listed. Mild.

Vegetable Kurma.note: Cashew paste = tree nuts. Coconut is not milk; poppy seed is not an EU allergen. Not spicy.

Mushroom Pepper Varuval.note: Black pepper, fennel, curry leaves. Very spicy.

Jain Vegetable Curry.note: Stated no onion, garlic or asafoetida (so no hidden wheat). Sunflower oil. Mild.

Vegetable Briyani.note: Ghee and yoghurt raita = milk; cashews = tree nuts. Briyani is mildly spiced (label 1).

Banana Leaf Meal.note: Rasam and sambar with asafoetida = gluten; curd = milk; South Indian sambar and vegetable poriyal are tempered with mustard seeds (judgement call). Spicy.

Gulab Jamun.note: Khoya (milk solids) and flour; fried in ghee. No egg.

Rasmalai.note: Chenna and milk; pistachios = tree nuts.

Semiya Payasam.note: Wheat vermicelli; milk and ghee; cashews.

Mysore Pak.note: Gram flour (chickpea), stated no wheat, so no gluten; ghee = milk.
